objective: Find genuine reasoning/ranking improvement over a reliable matched baseline while frozen r5 finishes; do not substitute schema reliability for superiority.

mechanism_measurements.inputs: Completed episode RESULT.json public tool events, index/task-state presentation metadata and recycling counters only; no hidden reasoning, new gold reads or provider calls.
mechanism_measurements.interpretation: Nonempty index means at least one emitted index snapshot with entries; not independent proof of model use. Recovery means recorded tool attempt, not success. Most r4/r5 observed episodes finalize after first source delivery before a later confirmed-read index snapshot can be built. r3 exercised memory/recycling more often, but all11 jointly valid rankings tied. Partial r5 reliability is not accuracy or causal evidence. No subset changes denominator.

verified_binding_gap.file_catalog: task-state.mjs eventFact(list_files) reads body.paths. Actual native list_files output has total/offset/items/next_offset, not paths. Observed Closure index post-recycle state reports409 files but an empty paths array.
verified_binding_gap.method_catalog: eventFact has no native list_methods/list_runtime_methods/list_references/runtime_status specializations; these become generic observed markers. Previously seen method IDs, exact coordinates, pagination and unavailable-runtime reason are not retained in this projection.
verified_binding_gap.evidence_index: Current buildEvidenceIndex retains receipt-confirmed read IDs, paths, source hashes and line coordinates ordered by confirmed recency, not structural relationships or navigation frontiers. It never fabricates relevance, which must be preserved.
verified_binding_gap.ceiling: Verified representation mismatch and lost metadata, not proof this caused any failed ranking. Native history may still contain the outputs until recycle, and task-state fitting can evict facts. Pending outputs are not automatically confirmed delivery. Frozen canonical and adapter sources unchanged.

primary_research.title: LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization
primary_research.finding: Models code entities and structural dependencies for multi-hop navigation. Official implementation is available under Apache2.0.
primary_research.application_inference: Preserving observed structural navigation could help ARE retain useful search context. Current Java references are explicitly unresolved syntactic observations, not a typed dependency graph; do not relabel them or transplant Python-specific graph tools as validated Java behavior. No reported paper accuracy is an ARE expectation.

primary_research.title: GraphLocator: Graph-guided Causal Reasoning for Issue Localization
primary_research.finding: Separates symptom localization from iterative dependency-guided exploration and represents hypothesized causes rather than statistically validated causal effects. Experiments include Java; file-set/function metrics and iteration budgets differ from ARE's frozen task.
primary_research.application_inference: Supports investigating a preserved observed navigation frontier, without treating model hypotheses as source truth. Reproducing its causal agent would require separate interfaces, accounting and qualification; immediate candidate should remain deterministic and receipt-grounded, not store hidden reasoning or import its performance claims.

primary_research.title: Improving Code Localization with Repository Memory
primary_research.finding: Adds searchable past commits/issues and summaries of active code modules. Its corpus excludes commits after the target issue and filters overlapping issues and linked commits to avoid leakage.
primary_research.application_inference: Potential later cross-interaction evolution hypothesis, not a safe immediate Defects4J addition: future fix commits, target-linked issues and exact historical cutoff need independent controls. Do not search upstream fix history in current arms. Defer rather than bypass source-only campaign isolation.

primary_research.title: AgentFold: Long-Horizon Web Agents with Proactive Context Management
primary_research.finding: Uses learned multi-scale trajectory folding with supervised fine-tuning for web tasks.
primary_research.application_inference: Useful context-management motivation but not a drop-in hosted-GLM technique, and web performance does not establish code-localization efficacy. Defer learned folding; preserve exact source archives and explicit recovery instead of unverified lossy summaries.

selected_prospective_hypothesis.mechanism: Retain compact native navigation facts across context recycling: delivered catalog paths and method IDs/coordinates, page cursors, runtime availability and unresolved-reference posture. Build from exact successful request-bound public tool envelopes, not arbitrary event claims or filesystem enumeration. Preserve existing delivered-read handles and original source evidence, with no semantic relevance inference or answer-specific hints.
selected_prospective_hypothesis.scope: Separately versioned offline helper/adapter candidate first. Never patch frozen r3/r4/r5 or canonical task-state module. Treatment-side persistent projection only; both arms retain identical tools, source access and original budgets. At most original task-state512 tokens/4096 bytes unless a separate prospective comparison justifies replacing rather than adding overhead. All actual measurements and evictions accounted.
required_tests: Only actual confirmed successful request delivery creates a fact; pending, failed, uncertain and unknown-spend observations cannot.
Native items schema, method identifiers, exact coordinates, runtime-unavailable and page cursors survive deterministic serialization/reconstruction.
References remain unresolved syntactic observations; missing/zero never implies irrelevance and no source credit is fabricated.
Scope/case/source/capture/receipt tampering and duplicate or conflicting facts fail closed; no ambient gold, history patches or hidden reasoning.
Deterministic whole-fact eviction with explicit omitted counts; no method-body truncation, silent exclusion, unmeasured overhead or extra call/tool budget.
Native both-arm recycle, recovery, all32 actual-source qualification and independent canonical byte audits before any successor live freeze.
selected_prospective_hypothesis.evaluation: Before any live successor, freeze exact implementation/comparator, original full denominator and unchanged reliability/quality/cost gates. Assess genuine quality gain on jointly valid comparisons as diagnosis but never omit invalids from primary denominator. Do not advance solely on format validity, exposed single-case repair or synthetic tests.

independent_confirmation: Still required. Refresh complete recognized prepared/dispatched exposure union before fresh selection, keep gold outside selector/arms, predeclare population and practical effect plus appropriate project-cluster uncertainty and cost controls. Failed confirmation used for redesign becomes exposed; no repeated run-until-significant or retrospective REUSE guarantee.
no_effects: No providers dispatched, labels opened, datasets selected, gates relaxed, packages installed or frozen sources edited during this research boundary. r5 runs independently under its existing launch approval.
claim_ceiling: Candidate mechanism research and observed representation gap only; no demonstrated ranking improvement or superiority
open_questions: Does receipt-grounded navigation retention change actual model search behavior and ranking, not merely serialized state?
Can original512-token projection retain enough native facts without crowding out complete source or increasing cost beyond the guard?
Does full r5 reliably finish, and does its corrected baseline eliminate previously apparent ARE gains?
Which independent target population and protected evaluation protocol can confirm a substantial effect across the claimed product scope?
